privacy: Only this customer and the authorized provider team can view this conversation.
emptyMessages: No messages yet. Start a conversation about this booking.
failed: Unable to save. Your text has been kept. Try again.
denied: You no longer have permission for this action.
conflict: This booking or request changed. Refresh and review it again.
slotUnavailable: The proposed time is no longer available. The original reservation is unchanged. Ask for another time.
groupPrivacy: Each customer receives a separate private message. Replies go only to the provider.
proRequired: PRO is required to message the whole group. Individual messages and replies remain available.
scopeHelp: Review the affected bookings before confirming. Actions apply only to the listed bookings.
cancelWarning: The listed reservations will be cancelled. This action does not reschedule them.
requestHelp: The original reservation stays in place until the other person responds.
keepHelp: I would like to change the time.
cancelHelp: I cannot keep the original time.
keepConsequences: Approve: move to the new time. Decline: keep the original time.
cancelConsequences: Approve: move to the new time. Decline: cancel this booking.
noResponse: No response keeps the original reservation. It is not a rejection.
availability: The proposed time is subject to availability until confirmed.
requestSent: Reschedule request sent. The original reservation is unchanged.
declineWarning: Declining will cancel this booking. The original reservation will not be kept.
groupRequestHelp: Each booking responds independently. Unanswered bookings remain at the original time.
